_help: Training Room bridge settings. Restart the bridge after editing. port: HTTPS port for the headset/phone on your network; httpPort: plain HTTP on this laptop only (also for adb reverse); roomKey: code other devices need (delete it to get a new one); provider: "ollama" or "openai" (LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server at openaiUrl); model: "" picks an installed model automatically (names with "coder", then "qwen"); visionModel: "" picks an installed vision model (llava, qwen2.5vl, gemma3 and others) that looks at magic-marker drawings, else the text model reads them as ASCII art; think: false turns hidden reasoning off for faster answers, true on, null leaves the model default; sttKind: "whisper.cpp" (whisper-server at sttUrl), "openai" (an /v1/audio/transcriptions URL) or "none"; sttPrompt: optional words that help Whisper spell part names; ttsKind: "none" (the headset's own browser voice), "piper" (piper1-gpl HTTP server at ttsUrl, default http://127.0.0.1:5000) or "openai" (Kokoro-FastAPI, speaches or any /v1/audio/speech URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1/audio/speech) speaks the AI's replies with a laptop voice; ttsVoice/ttsModel: voice and model for "openai"; partsDirs: extra folders with parts (blueprint .json, .glb/.gltf, .js); allowOrigins: web pages allowed to call this bridge from another site.
